name: cover
prompt: Create a finished Korean blog cover raster image, horizontal 3:2. Topic: editing an existing Google document with Claude, approving changes before direct edit, checking facts afterwards. Toss inspired clear graphic composition, large confident Korean typography, generous white and soft cobalt/teal space, clean tactile paper objects; not a logo or official app screenshot. A large document sheet with blue edit marks beside a distinct approval card/checkmark and small compare-two-pages icon. Entirely new composition from previous purple AI photo magnifying glass covers, no magnifier, no photoreal computer UI. Exact big text only: '구글 문서' first line, 'AI가 고쳐줘요' second line; smaller but readable '승인 후 · 원문 대조'. Korean text crisp and no clipping. Core message is document edit and approval, not guaranteed error removal. No other words, no brand logos, no invented official UI. Opaque background.

name: infographic
prompt: Use case infographic-diagram. Finished Korean pastel handdrawn sketchnote raster 4:5 vertical for beginner Google Docs Claude editing article. Ivory paper, uneven black pen outlines, blue mint pale peach lavender panels, very large crisp Korean. Exact title '문서 수정, 사람이 결정해요'. Four spacious panels read top-to-bottom and connected by straight downward arrows meaning sequence only: 1 '문단 선택' note '독자: 바꿀 곳 정하기'; 2 '조건 적어 요청' note '독자: 날짜 · 금액 · 조건 유지'; 3 '수정 계획 승인' note 'Claude 제안 → 독자 승인'; 4 '원문과 대조' note '독자: 빠진 조건 찾기'. Small bottom two labeled judgment boxes no arrows except a fork from panel4: left '조건 유지: 채택', right '조건 누락: 되돌려 재요청'. Footer exact '기본 승인 모드 · 직접 편집 · 공개 베타'. Use little document/pencil/checklist line icons. No fake official screens, no guarantee of automatic review, no extraneous text, no crowding. Must preserve actor distinction and approvals prior to actual edits. All Korean sharp readable at mobile width. Opaque.

name: section1
prompt: Photorealistic explanatory editorial still 3:2 horizontal, medium-wide overhead diagonal camera in a bright calm home workspace, cool daylight with olive and cream colors. Two full letter-sized pages on a desk, one long paragraph paper and a second marked revised paper, pencil linking corresponding lines; beside them an open laptop shown obliquely with a simple abstract document on left and a vertical narrow chat panel on right. NO readable text, no company logos, no copied official software UI. Literal explanation of document editing in a sidebar in one place, clear two-pane composition on laptop so no office metaphor is needed. Focus enough environment visible and no hands necessary, realistic paper/fabric/wood. Generated conceptual illustration, not actual service screenshot. No currency, phone, magnifiers, flower markets, factories or theatre.

name: section2
prompt: Explanatory editorial still 3:2 with realistic tactile paper objects, eye-level medium-wide warm cream desk and deep forest green backdrop, natural side light. Large paper document on desk alongside separate upright approval card with a big checkmark, and a pencil STOPPED just before touching the document on a support; fine unobtrusive arrow only from approval card toward pencil/document. Literal idea: human approval precedes direct document editing. No readable words, no official app screen, no logos, no universal automatic processing implications. Realistic textures, clear uncluttered spacing, entire objects fully visible; avoid previous laptop composition, no person required. This is a conceptual explanatory still. Opaque.

name: section3
prompt: Create a clean editorial diagram raster 3:2 horizontal explaining preserving facts when shortening a notice. Very readable Korean, realistic cream paper comparison on light blue tabletop, three distinct values consistently highlighted in both pages. Exact top label '가정 예시'. Left page title '원문', right page title '수정안'. On BOTH pages identical three short lines in large typography: '10월 15일 오후 6시', '1인 2만 원', '결제 후 신청 완료'. Left page has extra grey nonletter scribbles representing longer prose; right has fewer grey lines. Thin central right arrow labeled '쉬운 문장' only. Bottom exact '날짜 · 기준 · 조건은 그대로'. Do not show a fake Claude output screenshot or official Google interface. Large Korean labels accurate, sufficient whitespace, values unchanged, clean blue/orange photographic paper lighting. Explanation focused on preserved details, no other labels or numeric claims.

name: section4
prompt: Photorealistic conceptual editorial still 3:2, medium-wide calm workspace in soft terracotta and pale sky palette. Two full paper documents laid side by side, revised one has three nonlinguistic cyan checklist tick marks and one orange flagged line; a curved counterclockwise arrow on a transparent acrylic card beside pencil visibly represents undo/revisit of flagged edit. No words, no official screen, no brand logos, no invented automatic accuracy certification. Literal reading and comparing a revision with the original, then undo if condition missing. Wide enough for whole documents, generous uncluttered margins, realistic natural afternoon light and paper shadows, distinctly different camera/layout/palette from section1 and2. No people necessary, no magnifying glass or folders/factories/markets.
